lines.text: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and planted a garden in Eden, in the east.
A river flowed out of Eden and branched into four headwaters, and the Pishon winds through Havilah, where there is gold.
The LORD God placed the man in Eden to cultivate it and forbade him to eat from the tree of life.

wrong_details.true: tree of the knowledge of good and evil

lines.text: The man named every beast and bird, but no helper was found, so the LORD God took one of his ribs while he slept.
The LORD God made a woman from the man's rib, and the man said she was called woman because she was taken from a servant.
